part.text:
Done. Built a TypeScript static site generator with strict mode, `marked`, `gray-matter`, and jest.

- `src/frontmatter.ts` — manually regex-strips YAML frontmatter (handles CRLF + BOM) before `marked` sees the body
- `src/ssg.ts` — reads `.md`/`.markdown`, renders pages + sorted `index.html` into `./dist`
- `src/cli.ts` — `npx ssg build` with `--content`/`--output`
- `tests/` — 21 tests covering parsing, build output, sorting, escaping, and CLI args

Verified end-to-end: `npx ssg build` works, `tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` clean.
